payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance metrics comparing the NUS and ABUS, allowing for a quantifiable comparison of their performance.

claims.text: The NUS achieved a 93.4% success rate and 13.8 average rewards, while the ABUS achieved a 90.0% success rate and 13.3 average rewards, indicating a performance improvement of 3.4% in success rate and 0.5 in average rewards.

In cross-model evaluation, the NUS policies achieved an average success rate of 94.0% when tested on the ABUS, compared to 99.5% for ABUS policies tested on themselves, showing NUS policies perform well on both simulators.
